description.value: You dig your hand into an open wound of a willing target, and at their behest you pull out all the blood from one of their ancestors. You transform the targeted willing half-breed into a full-blooded creature of one of its parent races. For example, a half hume, half elvaan, could choose to become a hume or elvaan. The target loses all of its racial traits and gains the basic traits of its new race. This does not remove their relation to their parents, and can still be detected as such via Detect Relations , though many see this as the most definitive means of disowning your parents.
